title: Signal: pnpm applies a local patch to a published dependency
scope: A pnpm-lock.yaml file that declares a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install.
limitations: It matches a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pnpm-lock.yaml that mentions a pnpm patch entry that rewrites a published package before install in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
